verification-principles.principle: Validate the smallest affected workspace first.
When shared packages change, validate the package before app consumers.
Use structured logs and trajectory review for complex runtime behavior when assertions alone are too narrow.
Keep verification artifacts aligned with semantic anchors, module contracts, and workspace boundaries.

rules.rule: Rendered surface page HTML must not contain prohibited exact-match strings (e.g. copyright boilerplate) outside footer elements.
Rendered surface page HTML must not contain prohibited whole-word strings (internal enum values like AIPlatform, commissioned-warpgogol-material).
Prohibited context-aware strings (e.g. Gemini, Organization) must only appear inside credit-context elements (figcaption, details, dl, [data-credit-context]).
Every AI-generated image (marked with data-ai-generated) must have a Konzeptillustration or localized equivalent label in adjacent figcaption.
Every AI-generated image must have a link to /bildnachweise/#... anchor.

check-set.scope: RFC-0505 ratgeber extended claim registry — structured claim records

rules.rule: Claim record missing required field.
claimId is not unique within the collection.
articleId does not resolve to an existing article record.
factual or regulatory claim has no sourceRefs entries.
calculation claim has no calculationInputs entries.
sourceRefs[].url is not a valid URL.
Claim with expiresAt in the past — needs review.
reviewStatus: disputed — claim is contested.
calculationInputs[].value differs from current PBP value at ref path.
claimId not found in claim record collection (RFC-0505: updated from sidecars to surface/claims/).
Article sources[].claimIds must resolve to claim records in surface/claims/.

check-set.scope: RFC-0506 ratgeber article JSON-LD — Article fields, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage prohibition

rules.rule: Article JSON-LD missing required field (headline, description, author, publisher, datePublished, mainEntityOfPage) on ratgeber depth-1 page.
Article JSON-LD author must be a structured Person object with @type="Person" and name — not a plain string.
Article JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage must be the canonical URL string, not an @id object reference.
FAQPage JSON-LD is prohibited on ratgeber depth-1 article pages.

check-set.scope: RFC-0507 ratgeber hub card fields and cross-page editorial alignment

rules.rule: Hub audience-cards block contains a card with a "description" prop — RFC-0507 removes description (summary) from hub cards.
Ratgeber article contains a markdown price table with 3+ data rows; /preis/ is the canonical price source.

check-set.scope: RFC-0377 route Markdown twin semantic frontmatter and body sections

rules.rule: Every generated twin must include semantic frontmatter fields: id, route, title, type, domain, audience, lang, metaDescription, priority, tags.
`type` must be a valid `SemanticPageType`.
`priority` must be a number in [0.0, 1.0].
`visibility`, when present, must be one of public, internal, experimental.
`schema` must be `gogol.markdown-twin@2`.
Body must contain a `## Summary` section.
Body must contain a `## Business context` section.
Body should contain a `## Data / APIs` section.
Body should contain a `## User flows` section.
Body should contain a `## Constraints` section.

scenarios.scenario: At least one feat → minor bump, patch reset.
Bump that would increment major → throws.
Same composite key returns cached result without AI call.
New key triggers AI call and stores result.
Key changes when files list or diffSummary changes.
SQLite opened with WAL journal_mode and busy_timeout=5000.
Auto-appends markers and content when markers are absent.
File written via tmp+rename (not direct write).

ldd-guidance.rule: Use LDD for reusable runtime logic, high-risk boundaries, and workflows that are better diagnosed by semantic traces than by a single boolean assertion.
Keep log messages structured, stable, and attributable to a module, function, or semantic block.
Do not add noisy logging to simple presentational code that does not benefit from trajectory analysis.

artifact.name: Markdown operator guide
artifact.purpose: Human/AI-readable walkthrough for task-specific verification, especially for new kernel workflows or operational scripts.

artifact.name: XML issue report
artifact.purpose: Structured failure capture that references the failing workspace, semantic block, observed logs, and suspected contract drift.

artifact.name: Compass inventory XML
artifact.purpose: Machine-readable repository coverage snapshot used to drive rollout waves and detect markup gaps.

wave-validation-gates.gate: The Compass inventory command must complete successfully before any mass backfill wave starts.
The Compass validation command must be stable and reviewable before being promoted into mandatory pipelines.
Shared package rollout should be validated before app-layer rollout begins.

entry.expectation: Consistency review is sufficient unless commands or tool contracts were changed.
Run package validation, then each affected consumer workspace.

entry.change-type: App route, middleware, content pipeline, or localization behavior
entry.expectation: Run targeted app validation and inspect logs or generated outputs where relevant.

entry.change-type: Shared page-block fallback or cross-page content reuse behavior
entry.expectation: Validate the owning package/runtime path, regenerate any generator-owned overlay pages, then run `system.manifest.validate`, `shared.context.validate`, and `page.block.validate` for each affected app.

entry.change-type: Published material changes: video sources, image tokens, material credit sidecars, or credits-page generation
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm exec site-kernel run material.credits.validate --site <app>`; for shared renderer or validator changes, also run the affected package build checks and the app `build:check` pipeline.

entry.change-type: Open-source page generation, SBOM registry, or downloadable artifact changes (RFC-0489)
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm exec site-kernel run open-source.generate --site <app>` then `pnpm exec site-kernel run open-source.validate --site <app>`; for shared generator or validator changes, also run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-codegen build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-checks build:check`.

entry.change-type: Contact form structured fields or send-message section changes (RFC-0514)
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm exec site-kernel run contact.form.validate --site <app>`; for shared section or validator changes, also run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/ui build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-checks build:check`; for migrator changes, also run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-handoff build:check` and `pnpm exec site-kernel run migrator.registry.validate`.

entry.change-type: Shared icon assets, exports, or generation workflow
entry.expectation: Run `icons.generate`, validate `@warpgogol/ui`, then validate each affected app consumer.

entry.change-type: Shared ontology / biome / site-family / token-generation contract
entry.expectation: Validate `@warpgogol/ontology`, `@warpgogol/tokens`, `@warpgogol/site-kernel-checks`, `@warpgogol/site-kernel-codegen`, and any command-owning package before running targeted workspace commands such as `family.contract.validate`, `biome.contract.validate`, `family.list`, and `rfc.validate`.

Validate `@warpgogol/site-kernel-onboarding`, `@warpgogol/site-kernel-codegen`, `@warpgogol/site-kernel`, and `@warpgogol/site-kernel-checks`, then run `onboarding.input.validate`, `onboarding.phase.validate --phase=05-audit`, `app.boilerplate.validate`, `app.qa.validate`, and `sites-check.run` for the affected app.

entry.change-type: Internal site handoff bundle, migrator registry, or RFC-0221 schema changes
entry.expectation: Validate `@warpgogol/ontology`, `@warpgogol/site-kernel-handoff`, and the root site-kernel command registration; run `migrator.registry.validate`, and run `handoff.validate --bundle <bundle-dir>` when a fixture or real bundle is available.

entry.change-type: Forge skill frontmatter contract or concerns taxonomy changes (RFC-0523)
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge test`; run `pnpm exec site-kernel run forge.skill.validate --all` to verify all skills pass SKILL-01..SKILL-17 validation including the four-level concerns enum, knowledge file existence, and platform reference prohibition.

entry.change-type: Forge skill knowledge file or cumulative knowledge system changes (RFC-0524)
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge test`; run `pnpm exec site-kernel run forge.skill.validate --all` to verify SKILL-13 (declared knowledge files must exist); run `pnpm exec site-kernel run forge.doctor` to verify knowledge file sync state.

entry.change-type: Forge skill file platform reference changes (RFC-0553)
entry.expectation: Run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/forge test`; run `pnpm exec site-kernel run forge.skill.validate --json` to verify SKILL-17 (no specific platform RFC/ADR ids or platform names in skill files); run `grep -rnE 'RFC-[0-9]{4}|ADR-[0-9]{4}' packages/forge/skills/` to confirm zero specific platform id matches.

Run `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-checks build:check` and `pnpm --filter @warpgogol/site-kernel-checks test`; run `pnpm exec site-kernel run generated.drift.validate --site ` to verify content drift detection (DRIFT-01 error + DRIFT-02 error for missing dryRun); run `pnpm exec site-kernel run generator.ownership.lint` to verify ownership map integrity.
